signIn.title: Sign in or create an account
signIn.subtitle: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password to remember.
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter an email address in the form name@example.com.
signIn.checkBody: If {{email}} can receive it, we've sent a sign-in link. Open it on this device to continue.
signIn.checkFootnote: The link expires shortly and works once. We'll never ask you for it.
signIn.pasteHint: If the link won't open, paste the code from the email here.
signIn.recovery: I can't get into my account
signIn.linkExpired: That link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
signIn.usePhone: Sign in with a phone number

recovery.title: Recover your account
recovery.subtitle: We'll email {{email}} a recovery link. Using it signs you out everywhere else on purpose — if someone else has your account, this is what removes them.
recovery.sent: If that address can receive it, a recovery link is on its way.

invitation.title: You've been invited
invitation.signInFirstBody: Sign in with the address this invitation was sent to, and we'll bring you straight back here.
invitation.wrongAccountTitle: This invitation is for a different address
invitation.wrongAccountBody: It was sent to {{email}}. You're signed in as {{current}}. Sign in with the invited address, or ask {{organization}} to send a new invitation to the address you use.
invitation.wrongAccountAction: Sign in with a different account
invitation.expiredBody: Ask {{organization}} to send you a new one. Nothing has been added to your account.
invitation.usedTitle: This invitation has already been used
invitation.usedBody: If that was you, {{organization}} is already on your account. If it wasn't, contact them before continuing.
invitation.revokedBody: {{organization}} withdrew it. Ask them to send a new one if you still need access.
invitation.alreadyMemberBody: Nothing to do — your work services are on the Home tab.
invitation.invalidBody: The link may be incomplete. Open it again from the original message, or ask for a new one.
invitation.acceptedBody: Any services they assign to you will appear on Home and My Line.

home.noServiceTitle: You don't have a service yet
home.noServiceBody: Choose a plan to get data, calling, or both. Calling over the internet works without an eSIM.
home.pendingTitle: Your order is being set up
home.pendingBody: We've got your payment. Setting up a line with the network usually takes a few minutes — you don't need to keep the app open.
home.pendingFootnote: We'll tell you as soon as it's ready.
home.installTitle: One step left: install your eSIM
home.installBody: Your line is ready. Install the profile on this phone to start using it.
home.failedTitle: We couldn't set up this order
home.failedBody: You have not been left without a route out — check the order for what happened and what to do next.
home.expiredBody: Its allowance is no longer available. Buying a new plan takes a minute.
home.suspendedBody: It stops carrying traffic until it's topped up.
home.loadError: We couldn't load your services just now.
home.unavailableBody: Check your connection and try again. Your account has not been changed.

placeholder.plansBody: Browsing, quotes and checkout arrive with the purchase journey.
placeholder.myLineBody: Your number, installation and usage arrive with the line and installation work.
placeholder.accountBody: Receipts, support and account settings arrive with the account work.
placeholder.owner: Assigned to chunk {{chunk}} — not built yet.
